options.text: Offer your own scribes to cover the lost work.
Respect [character] request to keep [character].

events.text: Being blind, [character] is denied most roles in the court. However, the ambitious [family] scion has made a plea to be allowed to join the [religion] clergy, dedicating his life to. [character] of the [family] is displeased by the idea, claiming that [character] plays an important role in the family’s administration.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Fable of Aesop

options.text: Preserve the fables for the libraries.
Ignore your duties to practice telling the stories yourself.
Punish the priests for inflicting such a drastic penalty.

events.text: [character] comes to you with the tale of a storyteller called Aesop, a mute slave given a voice by the gods after showing kindness to an Egyptian priest of Isis. The muses then gave him inspiration to tell tales, with which he outwitted his philosopher master to gain his freedom. The storyteller traveled widely until he reached [city]. His stories denounced the greed of the [religion] and they forced him to jump to his death as punishment for his impiety. [character] has come into possession of Aesop's tablets of tales confiscated by the. What will you do with Aesop's fables?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Fire Extinguished

options.text: Scapegoat all [religion] followers for the crime.
Execute the prisoners for their sins against the religion.
Let the people go to avoid antagonizing [religion].

events.text: The fires of [religion] are far more important than any temple. Representation of the divine light of Atar, they are the central aspect of the religion's rituals. Chaos has broken out in [city] after [religion] troublemakers targeted the fire, extinguishing it before the priests could stop them. The perpetrators have been caught and are awaiting your judgment.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Hearers

options.text: Offer alms and protection to the Elect.
Undergo your weekly atonement and confession.
Seek to better yourself with reflection.

events.text: The Elect, the clergy of [religion], are held to the highest standards, living by a strict regime of avoiding alcohol, meat, sex or working for money. Instead, their days are spent in worship or teaching. The laypeople, known as Hearers, follow similar but less strict rules. Alongside partaking in worship, their main role is to give aid to the Elect. Being a part of the church is a constant journey, how will you serve the church of Mani?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Judges

options.text: Emulate the justice of the judges in your rule.
Prepare yourself to fight for and your people.
Your own style of rule will bring honor as long as you have loyalty to.

events.text: In your studies of the you have been reflecting on the rule of previous [religion] leaders, the judges who fought to protect their people and establish justice amongst the [religion] tribes. Will you emulate these leaders?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Law of

options.text: Accept the teachings of the into your laws.
Welcome the teachings of your State Religion.
Refuse to make the proposed changes.

events.text: [character] is a strong advocate for the [religion] cause in [rival]. The's latest pursuit is the idea that the nation should adopt the law of [law], particularly favored by followers of [religion]. [character] has gathered a council of his fellow, experts in the matters of law, and offers to put them at your disposal to make the changes. Will this religious influence be allowed?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Madness of Magic

options.text: Offer a rebuttal to [character] speech, claiming magic to be a natural part of life.
Order a limitation on the influence of philosophers.

events.text: [character] has locked horns with [character], writing a speech on the dangers of magic and the corrupting influence that the pursuit of such a "monstrous craft" has. The Scientist is especially strict on the philosophers of the nation, saying that it is the place of the wise to avoid such knowledge, rather than attempting to learn it as many philosophers have.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Mysteries Profaned

tip: As leader: -40 Opinion with all Religions

options.text: Declare it is no crime to share the Mysteries.
Proclaim [character] innocence.
Death is the only suitable punishment for such impiety.

events.text: The rites of the <p.is_sub.S0=SUBJECT_CITY_CULT_MITHRAS>Cult Of Mithras<p=SUBJECT_CITY_CULT_ISIS>Cult Of Isis And Serapis<p=SUBJECT_CITY_CULT_MOTHER>Cult Of The Mother<p=SUBJECT_CITY_CULT_ECSTATIC>Ecstatic Cult<p=SUBJECT_CITY_CULT_DUAL>Dual Cult<p=SUBJECT_CITY_CULT_AMAZON>Amazon Cult<p=SUBJECT_CITY_CULT_CAVALRY>Cavalry Cult<p=SUBJECT_CITY_CULT_SWORD>Sword Cult<else>local cult<end> in [city] are a closely guarded secret, only known to those initiated into the divine Mysteries. So it is no small matter when [character], himself a member, is accused by [character] of sharing the secrets of the cult by conducting a private ceremony with some of his non-initiated friends. The accusations are confirmed by one of [character] servants, but the General counters that they are false claims made by his political opponents.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The New Apostles

options.text: Let [character] go to [rival].
Promise to support [character] work in [rival].
[character] thinks too highly of himself to make demands.

events.text: The followers of Mani styled themselves as apostles, especially after the prophet's death. Now [character] is gathering his own group of apostles, and has picked [character] as suitable to follow him and join his work in [rival]. [character] seems willing, but are you ready to lose him to the faith?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The One God

options.text: Levy a tax on the [religion] but excuse them from sacrifices.
No, everyone must make sacrifices to the ruler cult.

events.text: The [religion] of [city] rile against the laws of your Divine Rule, saying that the sacrifices to your cult image are an insult to their god. Your advisors suggest that accommodations could be made for this strange religion with only the one deity.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Other Side

tip: As leader: -40 Opinion with all Religions

options.text: Declaim the gods' ability to take anything from you.
Spend time with those close to you, reflecting on what the gods might take.
Throw yourself into work to avoid the dreams.

events.text: The same dream has been haunting you. Night after night, you watch unmoving as the waters steadily rise, silently enveloping the people around you until you alone remain. You can still feel that water climbing your neck when you wake. Finally [character] offers an explanation, reading from a book of dreams he has collected. He claims that it is a message from the gods, and previous occurrences of the dream have ended with the dreamer losing someone close to them.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Prediction of [character]

options.text: Bring this man to court as a scholar.
[character] will make a fine general.
We have no use for his services.

events.text: News reaches you of a suppressed [religion] rebellion in [city]. Surrounded and trapped in a cave, the remaining rebels refused to surrender and decided to die together, taking lots to determine who would be the next to be killed. This grisly tale is relayed by the last survivor, who surrendered himself to the authorities. This survivor, the erudite commander [character], swears loyalty and claims that he has been visited by a divine revelation that you will lead [religion] to great heights. Will you bring him to your court?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Seven Books of Mani

options.text: The illustrations will let us spread the word to even those without.
Only the written word should be sacred, or there will be too much room for misunderstanding.
It does not matter as they were all created by Mani to show the way.

events.text: More than any other, [religion] is a religion of the book. The Seven books of Mani are the sacred source of Mani's wisdom on the World of Light and lay out the path to paradise. [character] is uncertain on whether these holy teachings include the book of Mani's art, in which he painted depictions of the religion's cosmogony. Arguments over the sanctity of these scriptures has reached a breaking point. The [title] turns to you for advice to avoid a rift in the clergy.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Soul of Life

options.text: Give [character] the scribes he needs.
Refuse the request for resources.

events.text: The writings of [religion] say that there are nine parts to the human soul, each a part of a person's life on earth. [character] has asked for funding to write down the spells that will help the soul through the afterlife, the Book of Coming Forth by Day. These spells are to remind the soul how to live without a physical body, an essential role in the continuation of life. Will you devote resources to this project?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Soul of Sacrifice

options.text: Demand that the [family] stop their sacrifices.
Allow the sacrifices to continue.

events.text: From his position in your court, [character] has a remarkably strong influence on the [religion] community. The Priest has set his sights on stopping animal sacrifices to the pagan gods, bringing a complaint before the court that the [family] are still observing this abhorrent act, an unseemly practice to the [religion].

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Temple Besieged

options.text: Force the [religion] leaders to repair the statues and send troops to protect the shrines.
[character] is doing's work.
Quell the fighting, but stay out of the religious dissent.

events.text: There is chaos in [city]. In a show of dominance, [character] has led a [religion] mob to the city center and besieged the shrine. Although the city guards allowed the people within to escape, the statues of the [religion] gods were dragged out of the city, smashed and burned.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Tophet

options.text: Light the ritual fires.
It has not become so desperate.

events.text: In times of crisis, sacrifices can be necessary. As [rival] struggles in the war against [rival], [character] has suggested that the old practice of sacrifice at the Tophet is used to ward of the collapse of [rival] as it reputably did in the past. The ritual sees people, wearing smiling masks so that the gods won't see their tears, sacrificed in the fire of Ba'al Hammon. Shall such an extreme measure be used again?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Vestal

options.text: Commit [character] to live in chastity to atone to Vesta.
Instruct [character] to pay a fine to the temple.

tip: As leader: -40 Opinion with all Religions

options.text: Give a slight reprimand, allowing [character] to continue in his impious ways.

events.text: [character], ever on the search for a new conquest, has been accused of pursuing one of the priestesses of Vesta. The Vestals hold their chastity as a sacred vow. Although [character] schemes were not completed, the sacred fire tended by the priestesses went out last night. [character] has punished the priestesses for this failure of duty but claims that it is a sign that the goddess is angry. He asks you to punish [character] to appease the slighted Vesta.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Voice in Your Ear

options.text: [character] is right, [character] must leave the court.
[character] is a trusted advisor, and not to be questioned.
Exile is not enough, [character] influence should be completely removed.

events.text: [character] is furious at the attention and favor that [character] has received, arguing that a practitioner of magic should have no place giving counsel to the [title]. The demands that magic should be expelled from the court.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Voice of

options.text: Agree to follow the ways of.
Politely refuse the offer.
Exile the meddling.

events.text: A part of the [religion] clergy, [character] has decided that a part of his role as a is to lead you from your own godless ways. <p.is_sub.S0=SUBJECT_PIOUS>A pious and serious teacher<p=SUBJECT_RIGHTEOUS>Imbued with a sanctimonious attitude as inspiring as it is annoying<p=SUBJECT_SUPERSTITIOUS>Nervously pawing various religious charms and talismans<p=SUBJECT_HIGH_CHARISMA>Effortlessly drawing you in with an easy smile<else>Never short of willingness to talk religious matters<end>, he makes an effort to impart the teachings of <p.is_sub.S0=SUBJECT_ZOROASTRIANISM>Zoroaster<p=SUBJECT_CHRISTIANITY>Jesus<p=SUBJECT_JUDAISM>Moses<p=SUBJECT_MANICHAEISM>Mani<else>the gods<end> at every opportunity. How will you respond to these religious advances?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Way of Mani

options.text: Join [character] in his prayers.

outcomes.label: The Way Of Mani Cleanse Drunk
The Way Of Mani Cleanse Greedy
The Way Of Mani Cleanse Wanton
The Way Of Mani Cleanse Corrupt
The Way Of Mani Cleanse Proud

options.text: What nonsense.

events.text: In contrast to your own [religion] faith, [character] is a follower of [religion]. One evening you come across him performing a ritual of cleansing with water before prostrating himself in prayer. Noticing your stare, [character] beckons you over. “Why not join me? The way of Mani can bring peace to a troubled soul.”

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Whore of Babylon

options.text: Execute the Bishop.
Start a campaign to discredit the Bishop.
Enter conversation with [character].

events.text: The [religion] extremists in [city] have a new leader, [character]. The has been using violent rhetoric to rile up the crowds who flock to his sermons, equating the rule of [rival] to the great evil in the new books of Revelation, with [city] as the city that reigns over the earth. [character] says that such evil must be prevented, at any cost. One thing is clear, the influence of this wayward clergyman must be stopped.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The [title] and the God

options.text: [character] must abide by our customs and place himself beneath me.
Treat with [character] as an equal.

events.text: [character] is visiting the capital for a diplomatic trip, but your advisors are uncertain of how to treat him. The foreign leader may be a [title] but under the laws of [rival] you are above that, a divine ruler chosen by, if not even one of, the gods. Will you greet [character] as an equal or force him to make a show of recognizing your divinity?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Trial of Impiety

options.text: Send your guards to capture [character].
Reconsider your attitude to religion.
Double-down on your beliefs.

events.text: Your own impiety has not gone unnoticed, especially by [character], who dogs your every step in an attempt to catch you in a scandalous position. [character] suggests that he is trying to build a case to claim that your impiety makes you unfit for the role of [title].

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Undercover

options.text: Have [character] leverage his contacts to establish a network of spies.
Have the spread your influence through subtle propaganda.

events.text: Although a devout man of, [character] has a streak of cold and calculating darkness. Fortunately the appears to be fond of you and has offered to leverage an old contact in [city] to establish an information network in the city. How will you make use of this unlikely opportunity?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Undue Influence

options.text: Place taxes on the practice of cult rituals.
Voice your support for the practice of cult worship.

events.text: The court are disturbed by the rise of cult worship in [rival]. Even [character] shares his concerns that the spread of these cults is undermining the authority of your rule and distorting the traditions of [religion] with their own rites and practices. You are urged to take action to stop the spread of the cults and their malign influence. What will you do?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Unworthy Cleric

options.text: Side with [character] against the clergy.
Remove [character] as a courtier.
Use your favor to keep [character] position.

events.text: [character] has been ostracized by the [religion] clergy for his disreputable ways. It is said that the [title] was known for <p.is_sub.S0=SUBJECT_IMPIOUS>his willful disregard for the sacred rites of the religion, putting in little effort to disguise his contempt<p=SUBJECT_DRUNK>giving most of his talks while drunk, often rambling on matters with little to do with religion<else>spending much of his time in various places of ill-repute<end>. The disgraced [character] begs for you to intervene to restore his position.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Upstart <p.is_sub.S0=SUBJECT_TRIBE_GAULS>Druid<p=SUBJECT_TRIBE_SCYTHIANS>Anarya<else>Priest<end>

options.text: Send your agents to ensure a smooth transition of power.
Agree to fight [character] remaining supporters for the promise of tribute.
Warn [character] of the danger to his leadership.

events.text: Turmoil is brewing within the [tribe], as [character] struggles to hold onto his position as [title]. The leader is facing an uprising from a popular <p.is_sub.S0=SUBJECT_TRIBE_GAULS>Druid<p=SUBJECT_TRIBE_SCYTHIANS>Anarya<else>Priest<end>, one of the leaders of the ancient [tribe] religion. The <p.is_sub.S0=SUBJECT_TRIBE_GAULS>Druid<p=SUBJECT_TRIBE_SCYTHIANS>Anarya<else>Priest<end>, [character], has approached your court, asking for [rival] aid in his bid for power. Is the promise of a loyal leader enough to sway you to help?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Wayward Cult

options.text: Remove [character] from his position.
Send your agents to spy on [character] and the cult.

events.text: The influence of the <p.is_sub.S2=SUBJECT_TILE_CULT_HEALER>Cult Of The Healer<p=SUBJECT_TILE_CULT_MITHRAS>Cult Of Mithras<p=SUBJECT_TILE_CULT_ISIS>Cult Of Isis And Serapis<p=SUBJECT_TILE_CULT_MOTHER>Cult Of The Mother<p=SUBJECT_TILE_CULT_ECSTATIC>Ecstatic Cult<p=SUBJECT_TILE_CULT_ANGELIC_DIVINE>Cult Of The Angelic Divine<p=SUBJECT_TILE_CULT_DUAL>Dual Cult<p=SUBJECT_TILE_CULT_MARTYR>Martyr Cult<p=SUBJECT_TILE_CULT_AMAZON>Amazon Cult<p=SUBJECT_TILE_CULT_CAVALRY>Cavalry Cult<p=SUBJECT_TILE_CULT_FALLEN>Shrine Of The Fallen Goddess<p=SUBJECT_TILE_CULT_HERO>Shrine Of The Hero<p=SUBJECT_TILE_CULT_SWORD>Sword Cult<p=SUBJECT_TILE_CULT_CONSORT>Gods Consort Shrine<else>local cult<end> has steadily grown in [city] due to the cult accepting initiates from every part of society. Your council are worried about the power that the organization now wields within the city, with many of the administrators, and even [character], now members. There are reports that the members of the cult are becoming increasingly antagonistic to your rule, viewing the authority of their divine as above your own. How will you curtail this religious extremism?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [title] for a Day

options.text: Agree to the substitution.
Refuse to hide away, even from the gods.

events.text: "The omens are dire, my [title]." [character] stands before you with an entourage of scholars and scribes. The [title] has been paying close attention to the signs sent by the gods and is particularly worried about a recent eclipse that darkened the kingdom, indicating that a powerful [title] would soon die. [character] recommends that the ritual of substitution be performed to protect your life. A substitute will be found to nominally rule for one hundred days, after which he will be killed. To ensure the omens fully transfer onto this scapegoat, it is necessary that you enter hiding for the time. Will you hide away to save your life?
